summary: Defines a method for supporting GMPLS bidirectional label switched paths where the two directions have different bandwidth. It works with any switching technology and builds on RSVP's model. It moves the experiment in RFC 5467 to the standards track and obsoletes it.

eli5.summary: Most two-way paths have equal capacity both ways, but real needs differ, like fast downloading and slow uploading. This lets GMPLS paths give each direction its own size.
